## Cuegle (CR 5)

This alien-like creature only vaguely resembles a humanoid; its body is covered in coarse, black hair, and three tentacle-like appendages sprout from its torso—two from the shoulders, and the third from the center of its torso. A curving horn rises from its forehead, beneath which are three large, round eyes: one blue, one red, and one green.  

**XP** 1,600  
NE Medium aberration (extraplanar)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +6 natural)  
**hp** 52 (7d8+21)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +4, **Will** +8  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +10 (1d6+5), 3 tentacles +5 (1d4+2)  
**Special Attacks** endless teeth, temporal gaze  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 15, **Con** 15, **Int** 12, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 22  
**Feats** Alertness, Cleave, Power Attack, Toughness  
**Skills** Intimidate +12, Perception +15, Sense Motive +12, Survival +13  
**Languages** Aklo (cannot speak); telepathy 100 ft.  


**Special Abilities**



**Endless Teeth (Ex)** Whenever a cuegle confirms a critical hit against a target with its bite attack, it gains another bite attack against the same target in the same round as a free action. This ability can be used more than once in the same round.  

**Temporal Gaze (Sp)** As a standard action, the cuegle can fix one of its three eyes on an opponent during a combat, reading the opponent’s past, present, and future and using this knowledge to hurt the enemy and protect itself from attacks. Each eye has a different spell-like effect. The red eye functions as anticipate thoughts (DC 14), the blue one as mindshock, and the green one as true strike. The blue and green eye’s effects only work on attacks against the target opponent. The cuegle can use only one eye at a time on the same opponent, and each opponent can be the target of each eye only once during a combat. The cuegle can change the target of each eye as a standard action. Save DCs are Charisma-based.  

**Vulnerability to Oak and Holly (Ex)** The cuegle cannot stand the touch of holly or oak wood. Weapons made of these materials ignore the cuegle’s damage reduction. In addition, a structure or object made of holly or oak wood protects creatures within it from the cuegle as a combined sanctuary (save DC 15) and magic circle against evil.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any land (Dimension of Dreams)  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
